# Software Update Automatically Turns off Amazon Delivery Drivers’ AC During Dangerous Summer Heat

A software update to some Amazon delivery vehicles is automatically turning off the air conditioning after a few seconds if the driver is not in their seat, according to multiple Amazon delivery drivers who are complaining about the update online.

According to Amazon delivery drivers, the new update is for the Amazon EDV (electric delivery vehicle), the custom-built Rivian van. Delivery drivers say that this update automatically turns off the air conditioning in the van if the driver is not in the vehicle for more than 30 seconds. Drivers are complaining about the update as the start of the summer season, which can be [particularly difficult and dangerous](https://www.khou.com/article/news/local/amazon-delivery-driver-heat/285-101acebc-bda6-441e-a7e4-311c37a4b27a?ref=404media.co) for delivery drivers.

“As many of you are aware, the EDVs just got a software update where if you are out of your seat for 30 seconds with the side door open, the AC switches off,” one Amazon delivery driver said in an online forum for drivers. “We all hate this obviously.”

When reached for comment an Amazon spokesperson said that the premise of my questions to the company was inaccurate, but conceded that the van will turn off the AC after 30 seconds under certain conditions that are commonplace during Amazon delivery shifts.

“Rivian recently released a software update for Electric Delivery Vehicles that actually extends climate control for drivers,” the Amazon spokesperson said. “As a result, the AC now runs for up to 10 minutes after a driver exits the vehicle, ensuring a cool cabin when they return. The timer resets at every stop. The AC only shuts off if the driver sliding door is left open for more than 30 seconds — a battery conservation measure.”

Amazon delivery drivers discussing the update online say that they are getting in and out of the van so frequently, and are spending most of their time out of the van delivering packages, that the update makes it harder to keep the van cool.

“Thing is we are up and about waaaay longer than we are driving so the ac turns off and when it turns on again we are already getting up before im the air is even cold,” one driver said. “It effectively made the ac not work and those vans get hot as fuuuck.”

"Every Amazon-branded vehicle is air-conditioned—a feature that exceeds the industry standard—and if the air-conditioning isn’t working in a vehicle, that vehicle is taken out of service immediately," the Amazon spokesperson said. "They also have cooling seats for drivers. This update was intentionally timed ahead of summer to improve driver comfort during the hottest months of the year. Driver safety and comfort in extreme temperatures remains a priority. If drivers have questions about this change, they should touch base with the DSP they work for - as details about this change were shared with them."

Older delivery trucks may not have air conditioning or have air conditioning that breaks often. Delivery drivers for UPS, who are represented by the Teamsters union, negotiated a heat safety [agreement with the company in 2023](https://www.npr.org/2023/06/14/1182147381/ups-workers-facing-extreme-heat-win-a-deal-to-get-air-conditioning-in-new-trucks?ref=404media.co). Amazon has publicly outlined [its strategy](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/operations/how-amazon-keeps-employees-and-drivers-safe?ref=404media.co)for keeping all its workers, including delivery drivers, safe during the heat, including using an app to ask drivers to take 10-minute break from the heat by resting in a cool place and drinking water, but Amazon delivery drivers are managed by a nationwide network of subcontractors who drivers say [don’t always maintain those standards](https://www.npr.org/2023/07/20/1188282961/delivery-drivers-want-protection-against-heat-but-its-an-uphill-battle?ref=404media.co).

As you’ve probably seen in your own neighborhood, delivery drivers will often park their vans wherever they can and deliver packages to multiple addresses on the same block. Amazon automatically turning off the air conditioning while they are out of the van delivering packages means the van can get hot again by the time they get back. As Amazon delivery drivers have to make frequent stops, it’s not hard to imagine why drivers would complain about Amazon automatically shutting down the AC, which makes it more difficult to cool down between stops.

# 軟體更新在危險的夏日酷暑中自動關閉亞馬遜送貨司機的冷氣

根據多名在網路上抱怨這項更新的亞馬遜（Amazon）送貨司機說法，一項針對部分亞馬遜送貨車輛的軟體更新，會在司機離開座位幾秒鐘後，自動關閉車內的冷氣。

亞馬遜送貨司機指出，這項新更新是針對亞馬遜的 EDV（電動送貨車，electric delivery vehicle），也就是客製化的 Rivian 廂型車。送貨司機表示，若司機離開車輛超過 30 秒，這項更新就會自動關閉廂型車內的冷氣。隨著夏季的開始，司機們紛紛對這項更新表示抱怨，因為夏季對送貨司機來說可能是[格外艱難且危險的](https://www.khou.com/article/news/local/amazon-delivery-driver-heat/285-101acebc-bda6-441e-a7e4-311c37a4b27a?ref=404media.co)。

「正如大家所知，EDV 剛剛收到一項軟體更新，如果離開座位 30 秒且側門打開，冷氣就會關閉，」一名亞馬遜送貨司機在司機的網路論壇上表示。「顯然，我們大家都討厭這個設定。」

當聯繫亞馬遜要求置評時，該公司發言人表示，我向公司提出的問題前提並不準確，但承認在亞馬遜送貨班次中常見的某些條件下，廂型車確實會在 30 秒後關閉冷氣。

「Rivian 最近為電動送貨車（Electric Delivery Vehicles）發布了一項軟體更新，實際上延長了司機的空調控制時間，」亞馬遜發言人說。「因此，司機離開車輛後，冷氣現在最多可持續運行 10 分鐘，以確保他們返回時車廂保持涼爽。計時器會在每次停靠時重設。只有當司機側滑門保持開啟超過 30 秒時，冷氣才會關閉——這是一項節省電池電量的措施。」

在網路上討論這項更新的亞馬遜送貨司機表示，他們進出廂型車的頻率非常高，而且大部分時間都在車外遞送包裹，這項更新使得廂型車更難保持涼爽。

「問題是，我們在車外活動的時間遠比開車的時間長得多，所以冷氣會一直關掉，而當它再次開啟時，在空氣變冷之前我們就已經又要起身離開了，」一名司機表示。「這實際上讓冷氣形同虛設，而且那些廂型車裡面熱到爆。」

「每輛亞馬遜（Amazon）品牌的車輛都配備了冷氣——這是一項超越業界標準的配備——如果車上的冷氣故障，該車輛會立即停用，」亞馬遜發言人表示。「車輛也為司機配備了涼感座椅。這項更新刻意安排在夏季前推出，以提升司機在一年中最熱月份的舒適度。在極端氣溫下，司機的安全與舒適度仍是我們的首要任務。如果司機對這項變更有任何疑問，他們應該與所屬的配送服務合作夥伴（DSP）聯繫，因為此變更的相關細節已與他們分享。」

較舊的送貨貨車可能沒有冷氣，或者冷氣經常故障。由國際卡車司機工會（Teamsters）代表的 UPS 配送司機，於 2023 年與公司協商出了一份防暑安全[協定](https://www.npr.org/2023/06/14/1182147381/ups-workers-facing-extreme-heat-win-a-deal-to-get-air-conditioning-in-new-trucks?ref=404media.co)。亞馬遜已公開說明其維護所有員工（包括配送司機）在高溫下安全的[策略](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/operations/how-amazon-keeps-employees-and-drivers-safe?ref=404media.co)，其中包括使用應用程式提醒司機在陰涼處休息 10 分鐘並多喝水以消暑。然而，亞馬遜的配送司機是由全國性的分包商網路所管理，司機們表示這些分包商[並不總是遵守這些標準](https://www.npr.org/2023/07/20/1188282961/delivery-drivers-want-protection-against-heat-but-its-an-uphill-battle?ref=404media.co)。

正如你可能在自己社區中所見，配送司機通常會盡可能隨處停放貨車，並將包裹送往同一街區的多個地址。當司機下車送貨時，亞馬遜會自動關閉冷氣，這意味著當他們回到車上時，貨車內可能又已經變得很熱。由於亞馬遜配送司機必須頻繁停靠，不難想像為什麼司機會抱怨亞馬遜自動關閉冷氣的設定，因為這讓他們在每次停靠送貨的空檔更難降溫。
